reference_change.title: Fix min_pos when all negative + speed up

workload.command: python -c "import numpy as np; from sklearn.utils.arrayfuncs import min_pos; X = np.random.RandomState(0).randn(100); [min_pos(X) for _ in range(200000)]"
workload.source: adapted from the %timeit min_pos(X) case on 100 elements in the description of https://github.com/scikit-learn/scikit-learn/pull/19328

oracle.source: sklearn/utils/tests/test_arrayfuncs.py, which https://github.com/scikit-learn/scikit-learn/pull/19328 adds; targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: timings: 5.9 µs ± 35.5 ns; 297 ns ± 2.41 ns

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs (oracle required on the reference tree only: it names tests the reference change adds). Built without OpenMP (SKLEARN_NO_OPENMP=1; Apple clang has none). Python 3.8 is the oldest uv build here. The era recipe (dependencies released before 2021-02-04) failed: no macOS arm64 wheels of NumPy or SciPy existed then and they do not build from source here, so dependencies are the newest releases that still carry numpy.distutils and Cython 0.29 (the fallback recipe in eval/README.md). Built in place with setup.py build_ext: setuptools<60 has no editable-install hook (PEP 660)
